beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: There was a woman who had been suffering for twelve years.

timing.text: There was a woman who had been suffering for twelve years.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: She had spent everything on doctors. Nothing helped. She was exhausted, desperate — and by the rules of her time, considered untouchable.

timing.text: She had spent everything on doctors.
Nothing helped.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That day, Jesus was already on his way to save someone else — a ruler's daughter, twelve years old, and dying. The crowd pressed around him on every side. Almost no one would have noticed one more sick woman at its edge.

timing.text: That day, Jesus was already on his way to save someone else — a ruler's daughter, twelve years old, and dying.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: She heard Jesus was nearby. She did not ask permission. She did not make a speech. She said only one thing, and she said it to herself.

timing.text: She heard Jesus was nearby.

beats.speaker: woman
beats.text: If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

timing.text: If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If I can just touch his clothes, she told herself, I will be well. That was the whole of her plan. She pressed through the crowd and reached out to touch the edge of his cloak.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He stopped. He had felt it — power had gone out of him. The healing was already hers, given the moment she touched him.

Who touched my clothes?

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

timing.text: Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: His disciples thought the question made no sense. The whole crowd was pressing against him — who hadn't touched him? He ignored them. He was already needed somewhere else, and he stopped anyway.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He looked for her until he found her.

timing.text: He looked for her until he found her.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

timing.text: Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Be whole of thy plague — be free of what has been hurting you. Twelve years of it. Over, in a sentence. And the first word he chose was daughter.

card.text: Whatever you have carried for years — reach for him. He stops for the one. He calls you his own.
